# Skewness and Kurtosis

![Skewness and Kurtosis function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/statistics/04-skewness_kurtosis.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Sample0 divides variance by n-1; Population1 by n. GS corrected skewness/kurtosis uses NIST G1/G2 (not NI-certified); kurtosis is Pearson normal3. GS Sample uses adjusted G1/G2, Population uses central moments; Pearson kurtosis has normal=3.
